from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792545201/attempts/077c639e3ede471faa305f8b7291dc1f/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # The monochrome full-length bands are the marker lines; recolor them.
    line_color = next((c for c, n in counts.most_common() if c != background and
                       any(all(row[j] == c for j in range(w)) for row in grid) or
                       (c != background and any(all(grid[i][j] == c for i in range(h)) for j in range(w)))), None)
    if line_color is None:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for i in range(h):
        if all(grid[i][j] == line_color for j in range(w)):
            for j in range(w): out[i][j] = 2
    for j in range(w):
        if all(grid[i][j] == line_color for i in range(h)):
            for i in range(h): out[i][j] = 2
    return out
'''
path=programs/'task-22825a64.py'
path.write_text(code)
print(path, code)
